landing.subtitle: Dogs, cats, rabbits and more are looking for a warm home. Meet pets from shelters and people near you - no fees, no middlemen.
landing.recentSubtitle: Meet the newest friends waiting for a home.
landing.emptyTitle: No pets yet - be the first!
landing.howSubtitle: From first look to new home in three steps.
landing.step1Text: Filter by species, age, size and location. Save a search and we'll tell you when a new pet arrives.
landing.step2Text: Write directly on the site - no need to publish your phone or email.
landing.step3Text: Arrange a visit, meet the animal in person and bring them home.
landing.lostText: Post a lost or found animal. Neighbours watching your area will see it right away.
landing.shelterText: Verify your organisation to get a trust badge on all your pets and a public profile.
landing.finalText: Adopt, add a pet or share a story - every step helps.
